answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and let reputation grow only from attested work, never from self-declared claims. An attacker who wants to forge a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand separate stakes, like planting a garden where each seed costs real coin. The umber soil of locked capital makes mass fakery expensive, while honest agents earn their stake back with interest. One bad act slashes the bond, so a Sybil farm bleeds money faster than it can profit.
